acquisition method: For DDA experiments full MS resolutions were set to 60,000 at m/z 200
alkylation reagent: followed by TCEP reduction, iodoacetamide (Sigma) alkylation, and trypsin (Promega) digestion
cleavage agent: incubated in ice-cold digestion solution (trypsin 12.5 ng/μl and 20 mM NH4HCO3)
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set at 30%.
instrument: tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Orbitrap Exploris 480 MS coupled online to the UPLC.
ionization type: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry
labeling: Label-free quantification was also performed using the PEAKS Online X quantification module
precursor tolerance: Parent mass tolerance was set to 10ppm, with fragment mass tolerance of 0.02 Da.
fragment tolerance: Parent mass tolerance was set to 10ppm, with fragment mass tolerance of 0.02 Da.
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation (57.02 Da) on cysteine; variable oxidation (15.99 Da) on methionine; variable methylation on lysine

For identification of all proteins, fixed modifications of carbamidomethylation (57.02 Da) on cysteine residues were specified. Variable modifications of oxidation (15.99 Da) on methionine and methylation on lysine were specified.
reduction reagent: followed by TCEP reduction, iodoacetamide (Sigma) alkylation, and trypsin (Promega) digestion
